essence: The argument laid out on paper. A warm editorial explainer where documents, charts and annotations build a case the viewer can follow.
explains_by: Build the case: evidence arrives piece by piece and is annotated as it is read.
Real artefacts: the actual document, chart or headline, marked up.
Mark up, do not decorate: circles, underlines and arrows on the source itself.
